therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of cardiac afterload and fibrosis via endothelin pathway blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: change from baseline in treadmill exercise time at maintenance phase week 24

results.effect_size: median net difference 43.0 seconds in treadmill exercise time
biomarker_changes: E/E' ratio change: sitaxsentan -0.12 vs placebo +0.38 (net difference -0.5, p=0.4950)
Left ventricular mass (PLAX 2D): sitaxsentan +3.09 vs placebo -7.52 cm³ (net difference +10.6, p=0.3874)
Left ventricular mass (PSAX M-mode): sitaxsentan +5.60 vs placebo +4.83 cm³ (net difference +0.8, p=0.7038)
subgroup_findings: NYHA functional class improvement: 30 sitaxsentan vs 18 placebo; no change: 60 vs 34; deterioration: 6 vs 0 (p=0.5909)
Baseline NYHA Class II: 58 sitaxsentan vs 27 placebo; Class III: 38 vs 25
safety_signals: Coronary artery disease SAE in 3/127 sitaxsentan patients vs none in placebo
Cardiac failure congestive SAE in 2/127 sitaxsentan vs 2/64 placebo
Deterioration in NYHA functional class in 6 sitaxsentan patients vs 0 placebo

dose_info.schedule: once daily; titrated from 25 mg over 10-week run-in (25 mg x2 weeks, 50 mg x2 weeks, 75 mg x2 weeks, 100 mg x2 weeks + 2-week stabilization), then 14-week maintenance phase
dose_info.dose_modifications: If unable to tolerate upward titration, investigator could continue at current dose or reduce to prior dose

context.duration: approximately 6 months total (10-week run-in + 14-week maintenance phase)
